verdict_rationale: All factual thresholds for pain (35 independent records), recurrence (66 records), existing spend/WTP (37 records across 8 categories), solution gaps (18 records), and reachability (APMP 11k+ members) are met or exceeded with VERIFIED Tier A evidence. However, Gate 6 fails for the generic B2B SaaS AE sales deck wedge due to enterprise enablement incumbents (Highspot AutoDocs, Seismic LiveDocs), web proposal displacement (Storydoc, Qwilr), and efficient 10-15 minute master template workarounds. PASS is granted conditionally upon redefining the target wedge to Boutique Consultancies or CRE / APMP Proposal Teams (where Highspot/Seismic are unserved/unaffordable and native PPTX is mandatory) and verifying whether the OpenXML layout engine limits satisfy practitioner formatting expectations in Stage 2 interviews.
condition: Explicitly narrow the initial ICP away from general B2B SaaS Account Executives to either (a) Boutique Consultancies / Professional Services or (b) Commercial Real Estate Brokerage / APMP Bid Teams, and validate in Stage 2 interviews that server-side OpenXML template generation solves their formatting pain without requiring a full interactive slide editor.

unknowns: Exact percentage of time spent on narrative structuring vs. rote mechanical layout formatting across specific boutique consultancies.
Monthly deal/deck volume variability between junior boutique consultancies versus senior partner practices.
Budget authority and discretionary spending limit of boutique consultancy engagement managers without partner sign-off.

G4_repeatable_gap.threshold: >=10 verified records clustered around repeatable problems
unknowns: Whether a server-side OpenXML engine without font metrics can achieve acceptable layout quality across diverse corporate master templates.

r/consulting, r/CommercialRealEstate, r/sales, r/revops professional communities

G6_killer_substitute.threshold: No low-friction substitute solving proposed workflow sufficiently well at price destroying value prop
G6_killer_substitute.substitute_threat_assessment: Killer substitute risk is SEVERE for generic B2B SaaS Account Executives (Highspot AutoDocs, Seismic LiveDocs at the enterprise tier; Storydoc, Qwilr at the web tier; 10-15 minute master PPT templates at the low tier). However, for Boutique Consultancies and CRE/Proposal Teams, enterprise tools are inaccessible ($70k-$180k floors), web links are prohibited by clients, and manual design spend ($899-$15k/mo) persists.
unknowns: Whether think-cell will launch automated AI slide assembly, closing the gap for management consultancies.

candidate_icps.name: Boutique Strategy & Management Consultancies (5-50 FTEs)
candidate_icps.rationale: Decks are the core deliverable; consultants report spending 30% of their workday formatting PowerPoint; teams pay $899-$15k/mo to presentation agencies (24Slides, Superside); web links are rejected by corporate clients who mandate editable PPTX adhering to client brand guidelines.

candidate_icps.name: Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Brokerage Teams & Analysts
candidate_icps.rationale: Brokerages produce recurring 30-50 page Offering Memorandums (OMs) combining rent rolls, property financials, and maps; teams employ full-time in-house graphic designers ($89k salary) or marketing coordinators solely to build OMs; incumbents like Buildout still require 12 hours of manual assembly.

candidate_icps.name: Mid-Market RFP / Bid Proposal Teams (APMP Members)
candidate_icps.rationale: High-frequency formal RFP pitches requiring multi-source synthesis (case studies, technical specs, pricing tables); reachable via APMP (11k+ members); but proposal workflows frequently involve complex Word/PDF documents alongside presentations.

candidate_icps.name: B2B SaaS Account Executives / Sales Enablement
candidate_icps.rationale: Enterprise enablement suites (Highspot AutoDocs, Seismic LiveDocs, Showpad ACB) already solve dynamic CRM-to-PPTX assembly for enterprise; AEs report 10-15 minute master template workarounds; modern consultative selling increasingly bypasses decks; web proposal links (Storydoc, Qwilr) are displacing PPTX.

candidate_wedges.name: Boutique Consulting Client Theme & Data Injector
candidate_wedges.description: Native PowerPoint add-in or CLI workflow that ingests Excel/data tables and interview transcripts, automatically mapping and recoloring them directly into client-branded PowerPoint master templates without layout corruption.

candidate_wedges.name: CRE Offering Memorandum (OM) Automated Assembler
candidate_wedges.description: Automated workflow taking property financial models (rent rolls, lease comps) and property imagery into standardized brokerage PowerPoint/OM master templates, bypassing the InDesign specialist bottleneck.

top_unknowns: Technical viability: Can server-side OpenXML generation (python-pptx) reliably handle variable-length text autofit and shape wrapping in arbitrary corporate templates without font metrics and without violating solo founder MVP limits?
Budget ownership: In boutique consultancies (10-50 people), do engagement managers have discretionary card-spend authority ($100-$300/mo) or does software require managing partner / IT consensus?
Template variance: How customized are boutique consultancy decks from engagement to engagement versus variations of a firm-standard 40-slide master?
Willingness to replace agency retainers: Will firms paying $899-$15,000/month for human slide designers trust automated software to generate final client-facing decks?
stage2_questions: When you adapt a presentation for a client or pitch, exactly how many minutes are spent on narrative/content drafting versus mechanical layout formatting, shape alignment, and recoloring?
What specific tool stack do you use today to build client decks (PowerPoint desktop, Google Slides, think-cell, InDesign, Figma), and what happens when you try to export or share with clients?
Have you tested generative presentation tools (Gamma, Beautiful.ai, Pitch, Copilot)? What specific failure caused you to keep or abandon them?
If a software tool could populate your corporate PowerPoint template from your data/notes with 100% layout fidelity, who at your firm would approve paying $150-$300/month for it?

For CRE brokers: How many Offering Memorandums does your brokerage produce each month, how many hours does each OM require from coordinators and graphic designers, and why is Buildout or InDesign still manual?
